title: Dynamic multi-specialty module auto-fitter (strips off-role starters and fills open slots <= max_price)
note: Policy-driven autonomous module fitter governed by game/fit-policy.json. Deterministically matches each pilot's division + specialty (ore/ice/gas, brawler/ewar/escort, freight/passenger, bursar/mobile, recon) and opens ONLY when a pilot has an off-role module to strip or an affordable slot upgrade within max_jumps (0ms skip when already fitted).
